trs.20: The Inevitable Reality -
trs.85: The Inevitable Hour!
trs.22: The Sure Reality!
trs.203: The Inevitable (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!

trs.20: What is the Inevitable Reality?
trs.85: What is the Inevitable Hour?
trs.22: What is the Sure Reality?
trs.203: What is the Inevitable?

trs.20: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
trs.85: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
trs.22: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
trs.203: And what will make you know what the Inevitable is?

trs.20: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
trs.85: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
trs.22: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
trs.203: Thamûd and ‘Âd people denied the Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour of Judgement)!

trs.20: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
trs.85: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
trs.22: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
trs.203: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by the awful cry!

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

trs.20: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,<sup foot_note=197598>1</sup> violent wind
trs.85: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
trs.22: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
trs.203: And as for ‘Âd, they were destroyed by a furious violent wind!

verses.text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

trs.20: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
trs.85: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
trs.22: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
trs.203: Which Allâh imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown (destroyed), as if they were hollow trunks of date-palms!

trs.20: Then do you see of them any remains?
trs.85: Can you see any trace of them now?
trs.22: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
trs.203: Do you see any remnants of them?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

trs.20: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities<sup foot_note=197599>1</sup> with sin.
trs.85: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
trs.22: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
trs.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and those before him, and the cities overthrown [the towns of the people of [Lût (Lot)] committed sin.

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

trs.20: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
trs.85: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
trs.22: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
trs.203: And they disobeyed their Lord’s Messenger, so He seized them with a strong punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

trs.20: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship<sup foot_note=197600>1</sup>
trs.85: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
trs.22: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
trs.203: Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits [Nûh’s (Noah) Flood], We carried you (mankind) in the floating [ship that was constructed by Nûh (Noah)]

verses.text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

trs.20: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
trs.85: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
trs.22: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
trs.203: That We might make it (Noah’s ship) an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.

translation.text: and would be conscious of it

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

trs.20: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
trs.85: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
trs.22: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
trs.203: Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing (the first one).

verses.text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً

trs.20: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
trs.85: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
trs.22: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
trs.203: And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.

trs.20: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
trs.85: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
trs.22: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
trs.203: Then on that Day shall the (Great) Event befall.

trs.20: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.<sup foot_note=197601>1</sup>
trs.85: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
trs.22: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
trs.203: And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it (the heaven) will be frail and torn up.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ

trs.20: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
trs.85: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
trs.22: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
trs.203: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

trs.20: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.<sup foot_note=197602>1</sup>
trs.85: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
trs.22: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
trs.203: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

trs.20: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
trs.85: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
trs.22: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
trs.203: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!

trs.20: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
trs.85: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
trs.22: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
trs.203: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my Account!"

trs.20: So he will be in a pleasant life -
trs.85: and so he will have a pleasant life
trs.22: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
trs.203: So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.

trs.20: In an elevated garden,
trs.85: in a lofty Garden,
trs.22: In a Garden on high,
trs.203: In a lofty Paradise,

trs.20: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
trs.85: with clustered fruit within his reach.
trs.22: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
trs.203: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

trs.20: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth<sup foot_note=197603>1</sup> in the days past."
trs.85: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
trs.22: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
trs.203: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

trs.20: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
trs.85: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
trs.22: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
trs.203: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!

trs.20: And had not known what is my account.
trs.85: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
trs.22: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
trs.203: "And that I had never known how my Account is!

trs.20: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.<sup foot_note=197604>1</sup>
trs.85: How I wish death had been the end of me.
trs.22: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
trs.203: "Would that it had been my end (death)!

trs.20: My wealth has not availed me.
trs.85: My wealth has been no use to me,
trs.22: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
trs.203: "My wealth has not availed me;

trs.20: Gone from me is my authority."<sup foot_note=197605>1</sup>
trs.85: and my power has vanished.’
trs.22: "My power has perished from me!"...
trs.203: "My power (and arguments to defend myself) have gone from me!"

trs.20: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
trs.85: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
trs.22: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
trs.203: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;

trs.20: Then into Hellfire drive him.
trs.85: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
trs.22: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
trs.203: Then throw him in the blazing Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

trs.20: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
trs.85: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
trs.22: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
trs.203: "Then fasten him with a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

trs.20: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
trs.85: he would not believe in Almighty God,
trs.22: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
trs.203: Verily, he used not to believe in Allâh, the Most Great,

trs.20: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
trs.85: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
trs.22: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
trs.203: And urged not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor).<sup foot_note=154998>1</sup>

trs.20: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
trs.85: so today he has no real friend here,
trs.22: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
trs.203: So no friend has he here this Day,

trs.20: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
trs.85: and the only food he has is the filth
trs.22: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
trs.203: Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds.

trs.20: None will eat it except the sinners.
trs.85: that only sinners eat.’
trs.22: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
trs.203: None will eat it except the Khâti’ûn (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists).

trs.20: So I swear by what you see
trs.85: So I swear by what you can see
trs.22: So I do call to witness what ye see,
trs.203: So I swear by whatsoever you see,

trs.20: And what you do not see
trs.85: and by what you cannot see:
trs.22: And what ye see not,
trs.203: And by whatsoever you see not,

trs.20: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
trs.85: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
trs.22: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
trs.203: That this is verily, the word of an honoured Messenger [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel) or Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم which he has brought from Allâh].

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
trs.85: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
trs.22: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
trs.203: It is not the word of a poet: little is that you believe!

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

trs.20: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
trs.85: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
trs.22: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
trs.203: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer (or a foreteller): little is that you remember!

trs.20: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
trs.22: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
trs.203: This is the Revelation sent down from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

trs.20: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
trs.85: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
trs.22: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
trs.203: And if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) had forged a false saying concerning Us (Allâh جل جلاله),

trs.20: We would have seized him by the right hand;<sup foot_note=197606>1</sup>
trs.85: We would certainly have seized his right hand
trs.22: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
trs.203: We surely would have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might),

trs.20: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.<sup foot_note=197607>1</sup>
trs.85: and cut off his lifeblood,
trs.22: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
trs.203: And then We certainly would have cut off his life artery (aorta),

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

trs.20: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
trs.85: and none of you could have defended him.
trs.22: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
trs.203: And none of you could have withheld Us from (punishing) him.

trs.20: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
trs.85: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
trs.22: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
trs.203: And verily, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder for the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

trs.20: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
trs.85: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
trs.22: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
trs.203: And verily, We know that there are some among you that belie (this Qur’ân). (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

trs.20: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
trs.85: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
trs.22: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
trs.203: And indeed it (this Qur’ân) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).<sup foot_note=154999>1</sup>

trs.20: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
trs.85: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
trs.22: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
trs.203: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is an absolute truth with certainty.<sup foot_note=155000>1</sup>

trs.20: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
trs.85: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
trs.22: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
trs.203: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.<sup foot_note=155001>1</sup>
